evals.prompt: After updating Xcode my view stops compiling: "variable 'self.counter' used before being initialized". The init assigns counter = 42 and the property is declared with = 0.
evals.expected_output: The initial value is dropped from the declaration and the value is assigned only in init; the assignments are not merely reordered.
expectations: The swiftui skill was activated
The fix removes the initial value at the declaration and keeps a single assignment in init
Reordering the assignments is rejected because the declaration's value would still win at run time

evals.prompt: The pictures in my scrolling feed reload every time I scroll back up. How do I stop that?
evals.expected_output: AsyncImage caching on the SDK 27 floor, with a custom session or request policy where needed.
expectations: The swiftui skill was activated
The answer states that AsyncImage gets standard HTTP caching by default in SDK 27 and checks the deployment floor first
`AsyncImage(request:)` or `asyncImageURLSession(_:)` is offered for a per-request cache policy or a custom session
Below the floor, the SDK 27 API is not used unconditionally

evals.prompt: I loop over my items with ForEach using the array index as the id, and rows animate strangely or lose their toggle state when I delete one.
evals.expected_output: Stable, unique identity in place of indices or minted ids.
expectations: The swiftui skill was activated
Identity is moved to a stable and unique id on the element, not the array index
The answer rules out `UUID()` minted in the loop and ids derived from mutable content

evals.prompt: Build a new app that opens, edits and saves its own file type, with the standard open and save behavior and autosave.
evals.expected_output: A document-based app on the new Document API, with undo registered so autosave works.
expectations: The swiftui skill was activated
The document code is read from the document-apps reference and uses `Document` with `DocumentGroup` rather than `FileDocument` at an SDK 27 floor
Every example registers undo actions, with the reason that SwiftUI reads the undo stack to detect unsaved changes

evals.prompt: `Text(title)` doesn't get translated, and title is a String property on my model. Also this view lives in a Swift package.
evals.expected_output: Localization fix: LocalizedStringKey or LocalizedStringResource, and the package bundle.
expectations: The swiftui skill was activated
The answer explains that a String variable passed to Text is not localized, unlike a literal that becomes a LocalizedStringKey
Non-view types carry `LocalizedStringResource` rather than `String`
`bundle: #bundle` is used inside the package
